entries.title: Matthew 11:1
segments: After Jesus had finished giving directions to his twelve Disciples, he left that place in order to teach and preach in their towns.

entries.title: Matthew 11:2
segments: Now John had heard in prison what the Christ was doing, and he sent a message by his disciples,

entries.title: Matthew 11:3
segments: And asked--" Are you 'The Coming One,' or are we to look for someone else?"

entries.title: Matthew 11:4
segments: The answer of Jesus to the question was--" Go and report to John what you hear and see--

entries.title: Matthew 11:5
segments: The blind recover their sight and the lame walk, the lepers are made clean and the deaf hear, the dead, too, are raised to life, and the good news is told to the poor.

entries.title: Matthew 11:6
segments: And blessed is the man who finds no hindrance in me."

entries.title: Matthew 11:7
segments: While these men were going back, Jesus began to say to the crowds with reference to John:

entries.title: Matthew 11:8
segments: "What did you go out into the Wilderness to look at? A reed waving in the wind? If not, what did you go out to see? A man richly dressed? Why, those who wear rich things are to be found in the courts of kings!

entries.title: Matthew 11:9
segments: What, then, did you go for? To see a Prophet? Yes, I tell you, and far more than a Prophet.

entries.title: Matthew 11:10
segments: This is the man of whom Scripture says--'Behold, I am myself sending my Messenger before thy face, And he shall prepare thy way before thee.'

entries.title: Matthew 11:11
segments: I tell you, no one born of a woman has yet appeared who is greater than John the Baptist; and yet the lowliest in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.

entries.title: Matthew 11:12
segments: From the time of John the Baptist to this very hour, the Kingdom of Heaven has been taken by force, and men using force have been seizing it.

entries.title: Matthew 11:13
segments: For the teaching of all the Prophets and of the Law continued till the time of John;

entries.title: Matthew 11:14
segments: And--if you are ready to accept it--John is himself the Elijah who was destined to come.

entries.title: Matthew 11:15
segments: Let him who has ears hear.

entries.title: Matthew 11:16
segments: But to what shall I compare the present generation? It is like little children sitting in the market-places and calling out to their playmates--

entries.title: Matthew 11:17
segments: 'We have played the flute for you, but you have not danced; We have wailed, but you have not mourned.'

entries.title: Matthew 11:18
segments: For, when John came, neither eating nor drinking, men said 'He has a demon in him';

entries.title: Matthew 11:19
segments: And now that the Son of Man has come, eating and drinking, they are saying 'Here is a glutton and a wine-drinker, a friend of tax-gatherers and outcasts!' And yet Wisdom is vindicated by her actions."

entries.title: Matthew 11:20
segments: Then Jesus began to reproach the towns in which most of his miracles had been done, because they had not repented:

entries.title: Matthew 11:21
segments: "Alas for you, Chorazin! Alas for you, Bethsaida! For, if the miracles which were done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

entries.title: Matthew 11:22
segments: Yet, I tell you, the doom of Tyre and Sidon will be more bearable in the 'Day of Judgement' than yours.

entries.title: Matthew 11:23
segments: And you, Capernaum! Will you 'exalt yourself to Heaven'? 'You shall go down to the Place of Death.' For, if the miracles which have been done in you had been done in Sodom, it would have been standing to this day.

entries.title: Matthew 11:24
segments: Yet, I tell you, the doom of Sodom will be more bearable in the 'Day of Judgement' than yours."

entries.title: Matthew 11:25
segments: At that same time Jesus uttered the words: "I thank thee, Father, Lord of Heaven and earth, that, though thou has hidden these things from the wise and learned, thou hast revealed them to the child-like!

entries.title: Matthew 11:26
segments: Yes, Father, I thank thee that this has seemed good to thee.

entries.title: Matthew 11:27
segments: Everything has been committed to me by my Father; nor does any one fully know the Son, except the Father, or fully know the Father, except the Son and those to whom the Son may choose to reveal him.

entries.title: Matthew 11:28
segments: Come to me, all you who toil and are burdened, and I will give you rest!

entries.title: Matthew 11:29
segments: Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and lowly-minded, and 'you shall find rest for your souls';

entries.title: Matthew 11:30
segments: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light."
